VI.description: Posts a message to the message queue of the window hWnd through user32.dll PostMessageW (stdcall\2C called in any thread) and returns without waiting for it to be processed. return value is the Win32 BOOL\3A non-zero on success\2C 0 on failure (call GetLastError for the reason). When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: Handle of the window that receives the message (HWND\2C passed as an unsigned pointer-sized integer). Read it from the VI Server property Front Panel Window\3AOS Window.
The window message (UINT)\2C e.g. 0x0200 WM_MOUSEMOVE. 0 is WM_NULL\2C which does nothing.
Message-specific LPARAM (signed pointer-sized integer). For mouse messages\3A x in the low word\2C y in the high word\2C client coordinates.
When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.

Indicator.description: The BOOL PostMessageW returned\3A non-zero when the message was posted\2C 0 when it failed.
